offence_note: Robbery, aiding trafficking in marijuana, possession of firearm while prohibited
sentence_quote: We grant leave to appeal sentence, and dismiss the appeal from sentence.
note: Length of main sentence not shown; 6 months concurrent added for firearm while prohibited.

offence_note: Sexual assault causing bodily harm; breach of court order
sentence_quote: The judge sentenced the appellant to five years incarceration for sexual assault causing bodily harm and six months consecutive for disobeying a court order.
note: Five years was after two-for-one credit on six months; total before credit computed as 6y6m.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual intercourse, luring of 12-year-old
sentence_quote: the global sentence of 21 months for these offences is a fit sentence.
note: Trial judge wrongly treated absence of guilty plea as aggravating; sentence still fit.

sentence_quote: Mitchell J. sentenced the appellant to four years imprisonment for kidnapping, four years imprisonment concurrent for robbery, one year imprisonment concurrent for arson and two and one-half years imprisonment consecutive for sexual assault.
note: 17-year-old tried as adult; 6.5 years after 2.5 years credit, 9y before credit computed.

co_offenders: McColm: nine months less time served (sentenced earlier)
sentence_quote: I am satisfied an appropriate disposition, as far as Mr. Robinson is concerned, is one of 19 months.
note: Probation includes any residential drug treatment if directed; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Historical gross indecency and indecent assault
sentence_quote: in addition to time served, the appellant is sentenced to a conditional sentence of seven months and two weeks on the usual statutory conditions on the gross indecency counts.
note: Total one year; 4.5 months served in jail; weapons prohibition set aside; youth/adult issue.

offence_note: Possession of marihuana for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: The sentence for trafficking falls away with the reversal of the conviction for that offence. However, that has no effect on the sentence for possession for the purpose of trafficking.
note: Trafficking conviction set aside; 12-month conditional sentence for possession stands.

offence_note: Possession of stolen vehicle; dangerous driving
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to 35 months in respect to the possession of stolen property count once credit for one month pre-sentence custody was given and 24 months to be served concurrently on the dangerous driving charge.
note: Court found absence of mitigating factors; 36 months before credit computed.

offence_note: Manslaughter by beating in crack house parking lot
co_offenders: Henderson: effective eight years less credit, appeal dismissed
sentence_quote: I would grant Mr. Richer leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and vary his sentence by reducing it by one year to three-and-a-half years in prison.
note: First-named appellant Richer reduced; Henderson's appeal dismissed.

sentence_quote: Accordingly, leave to appeal sentence is granted and the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: Trial judge rejected joint submission and imposed harsher sentence; length not shown.

sentence_quote: I impose a sentence of two years less a day. I credit you ten days for pre-trial custody.
note: Court recommended Brannan Lake Institution for family proximity; ordinary prison.

sentence_quote: The appeal from sentence is dismissed.
note: Endorsement gives neither offences nor sentence.
